reviews.comment: (Math 323) This guy is the worst lecturer I have ever had. He speaks so quiet and monotone that I never went to class and learnt the material from the textbook. His handwriting is also so hard to read. He only provides Math 304 exam reviews which are much easier than the tests. Don't take this guy.

(MATH 311) Prof. Lin is considerate and a lenient grader. However, his lectures have to be the most boring and uninteresting that I've sat through in 3 years. He provides notes and HW keys on Canvas but they are often illegible and skip steps. The one saving grace is that the final replaces your lowest exam grade. There are only HWs and exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Yukronkle was a decent prof. Very monotone and lectures were scattered. Tests are not too hard compared to other professors' I think.

Lectures drag and can be kind of boring.

Regardless, Dr. Lin is very kind. Homework, quizzes, and exams are straight forward. Quizzes and exams have lots of partial credit (except for the all mult. choice final which was not cumulative). Free response questions that are wrong are given specific corrections on Gradescope. 

USE THE TAMU MLC!!

Dr. Lin is a nice guy, but his lectures are so boring so it's nearly impossible to stay focused. Exams are not too difficult, but material of this class was not easy at all. Dr. Lin is willing to talk to you and fix the grades if needed. Follows all the math department grading rubric, standard web assign homework, and quizzes are not difficult.
He was an okay teacher but gave a lot of partial credit on tests and quizzes. The questions were very straightforward and not meant to confuse you.
The assignments are really straight forward and easy to follow. The assignments are pretty quick and cover all the exam material. Plus, he let me retake an exam when I missed it.

This Professor teaches from the book and somehow manages to do it poorly. He writes the equation and the proceeds to write ...=(the answer) and skips all steps. Lectures are useless and he makes all homework's do on the same day which is unreasonable. He is bad at teaching and his tests are also hard. I would not suggest taking this professor.

I had this professor for Linear Algebra (MATH 304). Linear Algebra was a hard class for me, but the teacher made it much easier, his explanations were easy to understand. The textbook is not required, yet it is good to use during homework as it explains some concepts that you may not have understood in the lecture. He is a really nice teacher.

Nice guy, ok professor. Weekly quizzes that alternated between in-class and take-home. It was his first semester teaching and I stopped going to lectures because they werent helpful. His redeeming quality was he gave lots of partial credit on quizzes and exams and the exams were identical to practice exams. He also gave a helpful practice final.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's definitely a nice guy, just not a great lecturer. Pretty dry and slow lectures, and being at 8 AM, I honestly stopped going, and self-taught instead. 10 quizzes, 30+ homeworks, 4 exams. Exam reviews are very similar to the exam. Lot of partial credit, is open to curves. It was his first time teaching at A&M, so I'm sure he'll get better.
